title: feat(ridk5): ridge-slide same-k holds at k=5: t=15 vs t=19
science: rho3 at k=5 on B_16: t=15 vs 19, 675>361. Notes the k=5 AXIS arrival coincides with mu's (both 15) while the body does not (19 vs 17) -- i.e. below the crossover the ridge clause moves only the body, which is why the margin is largest in the middle of the range.
